entities.title: zazz-format source
entities.summary: The five modules of zazz_format, flat in one folder: lib.rs (script ids), zip.rs, manifest.rs, pack.rs and sig.rs.
entities.purpose: Holds every rule a .zazz file must follow, so one reader decides what zazzled accepts and one writer makes the bytes `zazz pack` and `zazz sign` produce. zip.rs reads and writes the archive, manifest.rs parses zazz.json, pack.rs packs a directory, sig.rs handles the zazz.sig envelope and lib.rs computes script ids.
boundaries: Archives are read whole from memory and fully validated before any entry is returned; nothing is extracted to disk.
No cryptographic verification: sig.rs computes the digest and the signed message and carries the signature and certificates as bytes; zazzled checks them.
Every function reports failure as a String message; there are no error types.
